digest.component_or_area: DC outbound comment and description sanitization
propositions: DC backend lacks convergence test suites that verify oversized text truncates consistently across two passes, unlike Cloud which has such tests for both comments and descriptions

DC comment and description sanitization both bind to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) without documented provenance; the constant should cite jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519 as its source
DC convergence tests must explicitly inject sanitizer and backend mappers to avoid silently falling back to Cloud's configuration and proving nothing about DC behavior
Oversized DC comments and descriptions must converge (zero plan output on pass 2) when the truncated value round-trips through the differ, with truncation suffix persisting across both passes
